display.purpose: The start heading uses the display token.

body.purpose: Instructions use the browser's normal text size and the body line height.

components.css: @font-face { font-family:"Libre Baskerville"; src:url("./fonts/LibreBaskerville.ttf") format("truetype"); font-weight:400 700; font-style:normal; font-display:swap; } .ds-button { min-height:44px; padding:10px 24px; border:0; background:var(--accent, #d9ad6f); color:#211a12; font:600 16px system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:hover:enabled { background:#eac48e; } .ds-button:active:enabled { background:#c79959; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f3e5cd; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:default; } .ds-panel { box-sizing:border-box; width:min(370px,calc(100% - 32px)); padding:28px; background:var(--panel, #282218f5); color:#f3e5cd; font:16px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-panel h1 { margin:0; font-family:"Libre Baskerville",serif; font-size:38px; line-height:1.1; font-weight:400; } .ds-panel p { margin:10px 0 24px; color:var(--muted, #d6c6ac); line-height:1.5; } .ds-controls { margin:0 0 16px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.5; } .ds-controls div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:114px 1fr; gap:12px; padding:5px 0; } .ds-controls dd { margin:0; color:var(--muted, #d6c6ac); } .ds-start { width:100%; margin-top:8px; } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-panel { padding:24px; } .ds-controls div { grid-template-columns:106px 1fr; gap:8px; } }

components.css: .ds-button { min-height:44px; padding:10px 24px; border:0; background:var(--accent, #d9ad6f); color:#211a12; font:600 16px system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:hover:enabled { background:#eac48e; } .ds-button:active:enabled { background:#c79959; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f3e5cd; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:default; } .ds-secondary { background:#514536; color:#f3e5cd; } .ds-secondary:hover:enabled { background:#695a45; } .ds-secondary:active:enabled { background:#403628; } .ds-hud { box-sizing:border-box; width:min(330px,calc(100% - 32px)); padding:16px 20px; background:var(--panel, #282218f5); color:#f3e5cd; font:16px system-ui,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-speed-row { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; } .ds-speed { font-size:32px; line-height:1.1; font-weight:500; } .ds-unit,.ds-readouts { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted, #d6c6ac); } .ds-readouts { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-top:14px; } .ds-value { color:#f3e5cd; } .ds-meter { display:block; width:100%; height:6px; margin-top:10px; background:#514536; border:0; } .ds-meter::-webkit-meter-bar { height:6px; background:#514536; border:0; border-radius:0; } .ds-meter::-webkit-meter-optimum-value { background:var(--accent, #d9ad6f); } .ds-meter::-webkit-meter-suboptimum-value { background:#e98f63; } .ds-meter::-moz-meter-bar { background:var(--accent, #d9ad6f); } .ds-prompt { margin:12px 0; min-height:1.5em; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; } .ds-actions { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; } .ds-compact { min-height:38px; padding:8px 12px; font-size:12px; }

narrative.overview:
The player sees a rust-painted car, sand, and a hazy sky through the live game view.
Dark panels keep controls and fuel state readable over the scene.

Use original procedural geometry for the car, road, terrain, and roadside stops.
Use the existing warm palette when adding approved scene details.
keyCharacteristics: Warm sand and worn rust paint.
Serif headings and compact numeric readouts.

rules.name: The Scene Palette Rule
rules.body: Use warm material colors with the existing gray-blue sky and fog.

rules.name: The Heading Rule
rules.body: Use Libre Baskerville for headings and the system UI font for controls.

dos: Do keep the live scene visible behind controls.
Do use the recorded button focus states.
Do use the local Libre Baskerville font for headings.
donts: Don't import original Steam assets into this procedural scene.
Don't add interface features outside the approved product scope.
